claims.statement: The PDP/PEP model is the abstract architecture underlying all ZTA deployments
claims.evidence_excerpt: The airport security analogy — all passengers pass through the checkpoint (PDP/PEP), and the boarding area is the implicit trust zone. The PDP/PEP cannot apply additional policies beyond its location in the traffic flow. Moving PDP/PEPs closer to resources shrinks the implicit trust zone.
